propositions: Package-free by-path execution of reconcile.py raises ModuleNotFoundError when the binding-store commit helper imports git_adapter unconditionally at the top level without a parent package context.

The standalone loader contract bootstraps a flat-key helper module without creating an importable parent package, causing absolute imports to fail before the helper returns its documented True/False result.

The helper must resolve git_adapter through the existing sibling loader mechanism using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter and file git_adapter.py to restore standalone execution while preserving module identity and commit semantics.
Standalone and package-context execution must share a single sys.modules entry for rebar_reconciler.git_adapter to maintain behavioral consistency and cache preseed identity.
